name: tavily-search
description: Execute a search query using Tavily Search (via the Tavily LB key pool). Returns ranked results and optional answer/raw_content/images/usage.

query.description: The search query to execute with Tavily.

auto_parameters.description: Automatically configures search parameters based on the query. Explicit values override auto-selected ones. include_answer/include_raw_content/max_results must be set manually. May set search_depth=advanced (2 credits); set search_depth=basic to avoid extra cost.

topic.description: Search topic/category. Use news for real-time updates; general for broad searches.

search_depth.description: Relevance vs latency. basic/fast/ultra-fast cost 1 credit; advanced costs 2 credits.

chunks_per_source.description: Max number of relevant chunks (each up to ~500 chars) per source. Used with search_depth=advanced.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

time_range.description: Filter results by publish/updated time window back from now.

country.description: Boost results from a specific country (topic=general only), e.g. 'united states'.

include_images.description: Also perform an image search and include images in the response.

include_image_descriptions.description: When include_images is true, also add a descriptive text for each image.

include_answer.description: Include an LLM-generated answer. true/basic: quick answer; advanced: more detailed.

include_raw_content.description: Include cleaned page content per result. true/markdown: markdown; text: plain text.

include_favicon.description: Include the favicon URL for each result.

include_usage.description: Include credit usage information in the response.

name: tavily-extract
description: Extract structured content from URLs (via the Tavily LB key pool).

include_usage.description: Include credit usage information in the response.

country.description: Prioritize content from a specific country (lowercase plain English).

name: tavily-crawl
description: Crawl a website starting from a root URL (via the Tavily LB key pool).

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the crawler.

max_breadth.description: Max number of links to follow per level.

limit.description: Total number of pages to process.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns to include specific paths.

select_domains.description: Regex patterns to include specific domains.

include_favicon.description: Include favicon URL for each result.

include_usage.description: Include credit usage information in the response.

name: tavily-map
description: Map a website's URL structure (via the Tavily LB key pool).

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the crawler.

max_breadth.description: Max number of links to follow per level.

limit.description: Total number of links to process.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns to include specific paths.

select_domains.description: Regex patterns to include specific domains.

name: tavily-usage
description: Get aggregated usage/quota info for the whole key pool (local accounting, no upstream call).
